description: Expected distribution per (pathway, voie_ins) tuple. V0.3 stub — populated by Sunrise (LPP/Voie B). Enrich as missions accumulate. Banner heuristic uses `delta > 2σ` when baseline exists, falls back to absolute thresholds otherwise.

lpp_lppr+voie_b.notes: Voie B with audit_other_voie=true, audit_outcome_for_other=mark_na_with_audit_notes — produces 32 N/A scenarios in INS profil Référentiel d'identités symétriquement. NC=27 reflects Sunrise-specific gaps (PSC, IEPS, IEU, INS 45.x).
